gotchas: Never preload another owner's G6 system script from sim/ai. Use L.sys(name) + L.callf(script, fn, args, default); otherwise an owner's mid-edit parse error breaks the world.gd compile for everyone.
Create a new file before adding its preload (tree.broken incident at call ~37).
test_g3_no_hardcoded_defs: no quoted def ids in sim/ai except on lines containing role(, role_unit( or _ROLES. G6 ids come from PAGE_IDS page ids, which are not def ids.
st.g6 is the G5 module's dict; the G6 state is st.g6.use.
U.submit returns true once the command is queued. Validation refusals arrive later via scan_events (st.log REJECTED + backoff), so _park_if_stub only catches refusals at submit time.
tests/run.sh hides prints. For debug output run the raw runner: $G --headless --path . -s tests/run_tests.gd -- --only=test_ai_g6
Do not edit a bash script while it runs (bash reads it incrementally).
